name: fairdrive-contracts-in-transit
description: Ages every financed contract that has not funded yet (contracts in transit) by lender, with the stipulations still open, catches contracts funded short, money a lender sent that the DMS still shows as unfunded, and contracts marked funded that are not on the lender statement, and drafts the follow-up to a lender. Never submits to a lender or posts to the ledger.
